# Ski Manager

> Ski Manager is a free-to-play, browser-based online multiplayer ski resort tycoon game. Players construct ski slopes, install lift systems, hire mountain staff, balance daily operating finances, navigate dynamic alpine weather, and compete on global leaderboards.

Ski Manager combines deep economic simulation with authentic mountain topography. Players select a mountain location, engineer trail networks (Green, Blue, Red, Black, Double Black), build and maintain aerial lifts (chairlifts, gondolas, surface tows), manage guest services (lodging, dining, rental shops, ski patrol, first aid), and adapt to seasonal alpine weather. The game executes continuous simulation ticks, real-time weather progression, and competitive player tournaments.

## Core Systems & Guides

- [Getting Started Guide](https://ski-manager.net/guides/getting-started): Initial setup, starting capital, choosing mountain maps, laying first slopes, and hiring core staff.
- [Ticket Pricing & Skier Demand](https://ski-manager.net/guides/ticket-pricing): Price elasticity, skier volume formulas, marketing campaigns, and peak season demand.
- [Ski Lifts & Mechanical Upkeep](https://ski-manager.net/guides/lifts): Surface tows, 2-seater chairs, high-speed detachable quads, gondolas, power consumption, and mechanical wear.
- [Grooming & Snow Conditions](https://ski-manager.net/guides/grooming): Snowcat fleet management, night shift grooming schedules, moguls, and slope safety ratings.
- [Snowpack & Weather Systems](https://ski-manager.net/guides/snow-and-weather): Real-time weather, snowfall, freeze-thaw cycles, snow cannon infrastructure, and water reservoirs.
- [Staff Roles & Payroll](https://ski-manager.net/guides/staff): Mountain roles (ski patrol, mechanics, instructors, groomer operators, snowmakers, chefs), morale, and wages.
- [Resort Finances & Banking](https://ski-manager.net/guides/money): Revenue balance, bank loans, interest amortization, operating costs, and capital investments.
